arms.L0: live: fin fingerprints DAY/cluster_up (parts_up cut-outs, network G), WHALE_VIEW_GATE=blend: P and S.A take every fin / fluke fingerprint; ranking fluke / dorsal similarities gated by the view classifier; dorsal = labeling._match_code(student fin code, view_match fin cosine) as match.bin (VIEW_MATCH=mean)
arms.L1: WHALE_VIEW_GATE=all: P and S.A take the fin (fluke) fingerprint only of instances the view classifier calls dorsal (fluke), threshold of DAY/safe/view_class.json, stale boxes dropped as load_day. Ranking = L0 by construction (not scored twice)
arms.L2: W3c gate: a fin fingerprint counts (P, S.A and the ranking's dorsal term) only for instances whose W3c dorsal region exists (regions/<seed>/<day>.json 'reg' is not None, the falsefins_val.json rule). Ranking: dorsal term (student code and view_match cosine) only for instances the view classifier calls dorsal AND W3c has a region. Fluke and body as live. Seeds s0 and s1
arms.L3: W3c centre: fin fingerprint = G embedding of the 'centre' cut-out (centre.py; CACHE/emb/G <seed>_centre plus the missing ones made here, CACHE/live_e2e/emb_G <seed>x_centre); no W3c region = the parts_up fingerprint (centre.py rule). No extra gate (P, S.A ungated; ranking gated by the view classifier as live). Seeds s0 and s1
arms.L4: L3 fingerprints with the L2 gate. Seeds s0 and s1

unchanged_in_every_arm: stacks (safe clusters), sequence P, gap, body fingerprints, flukes (except L1), the stack phase (fluke / fin / rest) of the order of work = the view classifier as live, the view_match embeddings

modes.frozen: labeling_model.json 'pair' weights and 'blend' calibrations as they are
modes.refit: leave one val day out: pair logistic = label_assist fit (LogisticRegression C=1, max_iter=3000 on pair_training of the two other days, the arm's inputs); blend calibrations = the 2026-11-12 blend.py fit (C=10, max_iter=2000, stack-animal rows of the link-score order-of-work simulation of the two other days, the arm's inputs and refit P); held-out day scored. Weights 3:2:1 kept

measures.pair_auc: P as a classifier of same whale over every pair of label_assist stacks inside one catalogue scope (label_assist.scopes, pair_training pairs)
measures.pair_pr: precision / recall of P >= t over the same pairs, t in thresholds_P
measures.top1_top3: label_assist.simulate tau 1.5: stacks of a scope one by one in capture order, true animal first / in top three by its closest stack ('pair' val 0.843 / 0.987, 441 stacks)
measures.decisions_capture: label_assist.simulate tau 0.9 (runs, stop at frame traces): decisions on the 3 days
measures.first_choice: blend.py / sim2.py order of work (flukes, dorsal fins, rest by score; catalogue as the researcher; runs tau 0.9 both directions) on the page's stacks and matrices: first choice right of the stacks named; blend 3:2:1 and the link score P ('blend' chosen_on: 77.2 % / 77.9 % of 276)
measures.decisions_order: the same simulation's decision count (3 days; per day = /3)
measures.same_as_hints: pairs of (scope, catalogue animal) units in different scopes of a day whose best S.A (max over the three part cosines of the arm's P inputs, uint8 as the page) >= 0.85; true = same catalogue animal (merges applied)
measures.split: touched pair = both stacks have an L0 fin fingerprint and at least one of them holds a fin fingerprint of an instance the view classifier does not call dorsal; touched stack (top-1, first choice) = the stack holds such a fingerprint. Small bins: hints only
